text: Freya's moving into the new flat in Leith on 2 November 2026. Her brother Sam is driving the van up from Manchester the day before, and their mum is coming to help unpack that weekend. Freya says the kitchen is tiny but there's a proper garden. Remind me to drop round a plant the day after, once the boxes are in.
Aneesh has his driving test on Thursday morning and he's properly nervous about the roundabouts. Text him good luck that morning.
Picked up the dry cleaning and returned the parcel. Still need to renew the car insurance before it lapses at the end of the month.
Yusuf mentioned he's been getting into bouldering. Goes to the wall near his office twice a week now.
Pedro and his wife Dalia are celebrating ten years married in March 2027. They're thinking Lisbon, where they had their honeymoon.

Call with Tunde. His dad's having a hip replacement on the 14th. He'll be staying with his parents for a week afterwards to help out. I should ring him the evening after the operation to see how it went.
Fern's book club is reading Middlemarch, which she says is a slog. She's vegetarian, so keep that in mind if I host.
Bruno's band have a gig at the Lexington on Friday 6 November. Jess and I are going together.
Don't forget to post Vikram's birthday card by Tuesday. His birthday is the 29th and the post is slow at the moment.
Simone said the wedding's off. She and Marco split up in September, and she's back living with her sister Irina for now. Doing better than I expected, though she's struggling with work.
Book the boiler service. Dentist on 11 November 2026 at 9:40. Buy stamps.
Yetunde got the job at the architecture firm! She starts on 4 January 2027. Must send her a congratulations message tonight.
Adaeze is expecting her second in April. Her daughter Kemi, who's three, is very excited about being a big sister.
Duc is flying to Hanoi on 18 December to see his grandmother, and he's back the second week of January. I'm feeding his cat, Pho, while he's away.
Lindiwe asked if I could send her the recipe for the lentil soup. Do that this evening before I forget.

Aditi's PhD viva is on 27 November 2026. She's terrified, apparently her external examiner is notoriously harsh. Message her the night before to wish her luck, then take her out for a drink the week after, whatever the outcome.
Anjali has started learning Portuguese on Duolingo, mostly so she can talk to her partner's family in Porto.
Helen's mum passed away last Tuesday. The funeral is on Monday in Harrogate. I'll check in with her a few days after it, once the relatives have gone home.
Wei works in logistics at the port now, night shifts mostly. He hates it but the money is good.

Lunch with Abebe and Jack. Abebe is running the Valencia marathon on 6 December 2026 and has been training since June. Jack is going out to support him. Text Abebe the day before to wish him luck and again that evening to ask how he got on.

Anil's son Ravi is starting secondary school in September 2027, and they've just had the open evening. Anil is far more worried than Ravi is, mostly about the bus route and whether he'll know anyone. Applications close on 31 October. I should send Anil the link to the parents' forum that Helen mentioned, and check in with him the week after the deadline.

Ryan said his flight to Toronto got cancelled, so the visit to his brother is off until the spring. He was gutted, especially as he'd booked time off and his nephew's first birthday was that week. He's going to try again in April 2027, and in the meantime he's doing a video call on the day. Might be nice to ask him afterwards how the call went.
Need to call Matilda about the spare key before Saturday.
Nina Costa from the running club has a new puppy, a spaniel called Biscuit. She's absolutely smitten.
Reggie's retirement do is on Friday 13 November at the Red Lion. Chip in for the leaving present before Wednesday; Lucy is collecting.

Rachel and her partner Wei are hosting a housewarming on 21 November. She's nervous about cooking for twenty people, and Wei is no help in the kitchen, apparently. I said I'd bring a dessert, probably the lemon tart. Remind me to buy the ingredients the day before and to message her that morning in case she needs anything else picked up.
Zainab hinted that she's been after a decent pair of walking boots. Her birthday's on 3 December, worth remembering.
Freya's sister Fern had her scan yesterday and everything looked fine. Ask Freya next week how Fern is feeling.
Swimming at 7 tomorrow, then the big shop. Meal prep on Sunday afternoon.
Pedro told me his boss is leaving at Christmas, and he's thinking of applying for her role. He hasn't decided yet.

Jess has an audition for the regional orchestra on the 9th. Afterwards she's going straight to her parents' for the weekend. I should send her a voice note that morning and call her on the Sunday to hear how it went.
Tunde's daughter Yemi got into Leeds to study medicine. He was beaming.
Vikram Haddad, aka Vik, has taken up pottery and is selling mugs at the Christmas market on 12 December 2026.
Bruno is having knee surgery on 2 December. Remind me to text him the day after and pop round with some food the week after, when he's more mobile.
Irina said her son Mateo has his grade 5 piano exam next Saturday. He's been practising every evening.

Phoned Yusuf. He's thinking of moving back to Bristol to be closer to his mum, probably in spring 2027. She's been on her own since his dad died and isn't managing the stairs well. He's already looked at a couple of places in Bedminster and wants to go down for viewings in January. He seemed tired but settled on the idea.
Return the library books by Friday, and cancel the gym membership before the next payment on the 1st.
Simone mentioned her cat Olive has to go in for dental surgery on Wednesday. She's dreading it.
Aneesh passed! First time. Celebrating with him and Lucy at the pub on Saturday.

Coffee with Lindiwe. She's leaving the council in January to go freelance as a translator. Her husband Sipho is supportive but a bit anxious about money. She wants to do a course in subtitling in March 2027. I need to send her the contact at the agency, ideally this week, and ask in February how the first month went.
Dr Nguyen said to book the follow-up blood test for early December. Do it online tonight.
Adaeze and Duc are getting engaged! Well, they are engaged, as of Saturday. Engagement party sometime in the new year.
Matilda's grandad turns ninety on 15 November 2026. The whole family is going to his house in Whitby that weekend.
Helen's son Tom has his first parents' evening on Thursday. She's not worried; just curious what the teacher says.
Dalia is allergic to nuts, a proper EpiPen allergy. Remember for the dinner party.
Ryan said Jack is struggling since the redundancy. He hasn't been out much. Meet Jack for a coffee next week, no agenda.
Abebe loves old Ethiopian jazz, especially Mulatu Astatke. Could be a good gift idea for his birthday in February.

Wei's partner Lucy had a bike accident on Monday and broke her wrist. She's off work for at least six weeks. Must drop a card through the door tomorrow and ring Wei on Friday to see how they're coping.
Anjali's interview is on Wednesday 4 November at 2pm. Send her a good luck text that morning, then call her in the evening to hear how it went.

Weekend plan: Saturday is the car MOT at 10, then sorting the loft, which I've been putting off since the summer. Need to pick up paint, dust sheets and masking tape on Friday evening so I'm not running to the shop on Sunday morning. Sunday I'm finally repainting the hallway, and if there's time afterwards, the downstairs loo as well.
Uncle Anil is coming over from Nairobi in March 2027 for three weeks. I'm picking him up from Heathrow.
Zainab has a new job at the hospital, in the pharmacy. She says the commute is awful but the team are lovely.

Talked to Reggie about his garden for ages. He's growing chillies in the greenhouse this year and has far too many, so apparently he'll bring me a bag. His wife Matilda can't stand anything spicy and refuses to have them in the kitchen. He's also entering his marrows in the village show next August, which he takes very seriously.
Nina's choir is performing at St Mary's on 19 December. She's doing a solo and is very nervous. Text her good luck the day before, and ask her the day after how it went.

Irina and her husband are off to Japan in April for their twentieth anniversary. They've booked a ryokan near Kyoto for the first week, then Tokyo for a few days. Her son Mateo is staying with his grandparents while they're away. She's been learning a bit of Japanese in the evenings and is very proud of being able to order food.
Rachel's mum is in hospital with pneumonia. Rachel is up and down to Leicester every couple of days and exhausted.
I'm taking Freya to the airport on Sunday at 6am. Set two alarms.
Aditi mentioned that her brother Sam got married last weekend in Goa. Lovely photos. Send them a card.
Yetunde said she'd love a cookbook from that Nigerian restaurant in Peckham, which is a fairly unsubtle hint for Christmas.
Quick note: Pedro Barros owes me twenty quid for the concert tickets. Not chasing it yet.
